title: cafaye event envelope
description: The envelope every cafaye event travels in. CloudEvents 1.0-shaped: the context attributes below are CloudEvents attribute names and `specversion` pins the dialect. `data` is opaque here on purpose — the per-event payload schema lives with the publishing service and is referenced by its catalog entry in docs/event-naming.md. Contract tests validate the envelope; payload tests validate `data`.

specversion.description: Envelope dialect version. Increments only for a breaking envelope change; new attributes require a major bump.

id.description: Unique per emission. Consumers deduplicate on this (delivery is at-least-once). Never reused for a re-emission of the same logical event.

source.description: Publishing service, matching `name` in its cafaye.yml. CloudEvents' full URI form is /cafaye/<service>.

subject.description: Identifier of the entity the event is about, e.g. usr_01J9Z8. Platform-wide events that have no single entity use the literal `platform`.

time.description: RFC3339 timestamp of the state change, UTC. Not the transport time.

data.description: Opaque payload. Shape is owned by the publishing service.

eventType.description: <entity>.<action> or <service>.<entity>.<action>. Segments are lowercase snake_case. See docs/event-naming.md.
